events.title: Ironholm enters Early Access on November 5
events.summary: Hi everyone, I finally have a date to share. Ironholm: Reign of the Isles launches in Early Access on Steam on November 5, 2026. What's in Early Access 10 Challenge Path missions A prologue that doubles as a tutorial Quick Game on procedurally generated maps, for when you just want a single match Early Access also adds 13 Steam achievements. Play the free demo now You don't have to wait until November. The free demo is on Steam right now. It includes the prologue and two Challenge Path missions,

events.title: Demo Update: 13 languages, a new menu and a look at what's coming
events.summary: Steam Next Fest starts on October 19, and the free demo has just been updated ahead of the festival. Many of these changes come straight from your feedback. Thank you to everyone who played, filled in the survey or wrote to me. What's new in the demo 13 languages. English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and Czech. events.title: Nature Visual Update
events.summary: Hi everyone!Based on your feedback, I made a visual update to the nature on the map.The old vegetation felt too simple and too static, so I replaced it with new trees, grass, bushes, flowers, rocks, and small details. Plants now also have subtle movement, which makes the world feel much more alive.You can see the full visual update in this video:Thanks for the feedback and following the development of Ironholm!
